title: The Weather Today and Tomorrow
text:
Today the weather is very nice. The sun is out and the sky is blue. It is warm, so we can wear T-shirts. There is no rain.

Tomorrow it will be different. It will be cloudy and windy. Maybe it will rain in the afternoon. Bring a jacket when you go out.

questions.text: What color is the sky today?
What will the weather be like tomorrow?
What does the text suggest about tomorrow?
options: It will be hot and sunny
It will be cool and windy
It will be a perfect day for the beach

questions.text: Why is today a good day for a walk?
options: The weather is warm and sunny

vocabulary.definition: the space above the earth where we see clouds and the sun
not cold, but a little hot
with many clouds in the sky
a short coat that you wear outside

paragraph_translations: Hoy el tiempo esta muy agradable. El sol brilla y el cielo es azul. Hace calor, asi que podemos usar camisetas. No hay lluvia.
Manana sera diferente. Estara nublado y con viento. Quiza llueva por la tarde. Lleva una chaqueta cuando salgas.
